scope: Increment009 DEBUG T8103 single-CPU m1n1 HV development candidate
decision: Explicitly omit the unavailable CTRR and PPL implementations; do not claim hardware-locked kernel text or PPL code-signing protection.

implementation_selection.vm_backend: Actual public nos_arm_pmap/nos_arm_asm paths; config_pmap_ppl selects normal start.s, not XNU_MONITOR protection

reasons: Private CTRR implementation requires unavailable memmap_types.h/backend definitions.
Private PPL code-signing interface requires unavailable by-value CoreEntitlements V2 types.
Existing real M1 ADT capture, parsed by root offline, has no /chosen/lock-regs.
source_evidence: pexpert/gen/device_tree.c:248-269: SecureDTIsLockedDown returns false without the integrity implementation selectors.
osfmk/arm64/machine_routines.c:1574: rorgn_stash_range call is conditional on KERNEL_INTEGRITY_* selectors, not HAS_CTRR.
integrations/puredarwin/m1-bringup/CONTRACT.md: Source and build selection explicitly declares absent production protection.

built_image_evidence.provenance: Claude read-only built-kext/export review supplied in this thread; reports/sprint-009/platform-path.json revision3
built_image_evidence.rorgn_symbols: Reviewer observed none in the built kernel
built_image_evidence.ml_lockdown_init: Reviewer observed present; presence does not imply hardware lockdown

security_claims.ordinary_vm_page_permissions: Existing normal VM protection paths still apply; not equivalent to CTRR/PPL

runtime_implications: The missing lock-regs panic path is compiled out of this candidate; no fake lock-regs are supplied.
The host loader relocates the unlocked ADT into the post-kernel reservation so normal VM reclamation does not free it.
No bare-metal, full OS, or command-line runtime proof follows from this configuration/build decision.

guest_bootloader_policy.scope: guest copy only; explicit no-CTRR development build policy
guest_bootloader_policy.DTrace_effect: Permits SDT/systrace registration at boot; future root-enabled SDT/FBT probes can patch kernel text; ordinary VM page protection unchanged
